objective: Make canonical runtime Pydantic contracts reject unknown fields and implicit Python coercion while preserving strict JSON ingress for valid repository fixtures.
decision_supported: Can runtime producers and consumers rely on canonical contracts to fail closed without changing public JSON Schemas or the MCU Wire V1 contract?
acceptance: Canonical runtime models share strict Python validation and forbid undeclared fields at top-level and nested boundaries.
Boolean-as-integer and string-to-number coercion are rejected without requiring callers to pass strict=True.
TaskGraph steps and Observation hamming enforce the existing repository JSON Schema collection and numeric constraints.
Valid repository JSON fixtures continue to parse through model_validate_json and serialize deterministically.
SQLite WorldEvent replay uses one JSON-aware strict parser and rejects coercive or unknown persisted fields.
The World Model ActionResult payload adapter permits only explicit JSON string-to-enum conversion and then revalidates through canonical ActionResult.
The simulation CLI isolates its reviewed scene_variant extension while strictly validating the canonical ScenarioManifest projection.
No interfaces, MCU Wire V1 models, firmware, robot control, schema coverage policy or database schema is changed.
